messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Approval bottlenecks from single-point approvers",
 "problem_statement": "Claim processing stalls when reserve changes require approval but the designated approver is unavailable and no delegate is assigned. This creates backlogs because there’s no alternative path to move claims forward.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "We’ve had three handlers stuck for two days because their reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up... Claims are stalled because reserve changes beyond handler authority are stuck in an approver’s queue with no backup — approval waiting list is blocking everything.",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-17T13:03:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Yes, it’s specifically when a reserve change exceeds handler limits — the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-21T13:07:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We’re experiencing a reserve authorisation delay because when a handler tries to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it sits waiting for one specific approver who’s out of office and has no delegate assigned, so nothing moves.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-21T13:07:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "When a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there — that reserve authorisation delay has caused real issues for us, especially when the approver’s out and no one’s covering.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-18T12:10:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "when a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:08:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Not right now — just the approval waiting list is the big blocker.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-17T16:58:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Hi Bryn, we’re seeing claims stuck because reserve changes need approval but no one’s covering for the approver right now.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-21T13:07:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We’re running into delays because reserve adjustments above our team’s limit just sit there until the one approver comes back — no backup, no delegation, and claims pile up.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-17T16:58:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "When a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves until they return.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:08:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Morning Bryn, we’ve got a couple of claims held up because the approver’s out and there’s no backup — the approval waiting list is piling up.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:19:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Actually, there’s one thing — when a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-18T12:10:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "No delegate at all — and it’s causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before we can process payments.",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-25T10:50:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement and the customer quotes describing approval bottlenecks when approvers are unavailable. The feedback indicates that the product lacks an alternative path or automated fallback to keep claims moving when a primary approver is out, causing workflows to stall. This represents a gap in the product's approval routing capabilities that a squad could act on by building escalation or automated delegation rules.", "verdict": "pass"}
